stemMd: Suppose the additional condition is: Finance must precede Logistics. Which further statement must then be true?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Finance must not be in position 3.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Finance and Technology must occupy consecutive positions, in either order.

explanationMd:
First restrict attention to orders satisfying the extra condition as well as the original rules. There are 2 such orders. "Finance and Technology must occupy consecutive positions, in either order." holds throughout this restricted set; the other statements fail on the explicit examples in their feedback.

The remaining orders are:
- People → Technology → Finance → Logistics → Marketing
- People → Technology → Finance → Marketing → Logistics

distractorRationale.a: Even with the additional condition, People → Technology → Finance → Logistics → Marketing is permitted and makes this statement false.
